title: Define the project
description: Set the project scope, review precedent vehicles, and establish initial requirements.

title: Refine the response concept
description: Focus the operator-controlled, high-speed FPV drone on monocular scene mapping, with one camera and SLAM running on a ground computer.

title: Design the airframe
description: Develop and compare frame concepts for fast, stable FPV flight while carrying a single FPV camera.

title: Select motors and propellers
description: Evaluate motors, propellers, and batteries for a possible speed near 100 mph, accounting for camera payload and flight time.

title: Plan FPV capture and data link
description: Select one FPV camera and a compatible receiver/capture interface; define calibration, frame timing, buffering, and video input to the ground computer.

title: Simulate flight and failsafes
description: Use simulation to estimate thrust, stability, and return-home behavior, and test the monocular SLAM data flow with recorded FPV video.

title: Build the first prototype
description: Assemble the airframe, propulsion system, flight controller, single FPV camera, and control/video links for testing.

title: Bench and flight testing
description: Measure thrust, tune flight control, and verify camera calibration, frame timing, and the video link during operator-controlled flight.

title: Integrate and demonstrate
description: Run monocular SLAM on the ground computer using FPV video from slow scene sweeps, then demonstrate an operator-controlled, simulated emergency-response mission.
